verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is code-first. Agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, streaming, human-in-the-loop approvals and tracing are all exposed as programmatic primitives, such as the Runner class with run(), run_sync() and run_streamed(). The one UI surface in the evidence is the Traces dashboard, and nothing shows that dashboard capabilities (viewing, visualizing, monitoring traces) can also be done programmatically, so parity is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, programmatic retrieval of dashboard trace data, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can run agents via the Runner class. You have 3 options: Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), Runner.run_streamed()
The Agents SDK includes built-in tracing, collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.
Using the Traces dashboard, you can debug, visualize, and monitor your workflows during development and in production.
When a tool call requires approval, the SDK pauses the run, returns interruptions, and lets you resume later from the same RunState.
